For visitors

For riders over 60 with their own bike. RSVP on Meetup. Bring a spare tube for your wheel size and wear bright colours. Grades range from easy coffee rides to trail rides, so read each event.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 20 km/h: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Over 60 Peddlers Thursday ride group ride

Over 60 Peddlers Thursday ride is a social group ride in Auckland, New Zealand. It rolls every Thursday at 10:30 am local time from Changes weekly (on each Meetup event).

Weekday rides for people over 60 around Auckland: harbourside cycleways, coastal loops and some out-of-town trails, usually with lunch or coffee. Each week has its own leader, route and start.
